CommentItem.description: A review-loop item with its assessment, decisions and effects (RC4).

status_comment.description: Whether the item is a bot status comment.

imported_decision.description: Evidence of the current decision imported from GitHub.

import_proposal.description: A recorded GitHub decision awaiting confirmation.

llm_title.description: First sentence of the primary assessment description, cut at a word within 90 characters.

decision_follows_primary.description: Whether this item follows the decision on its primary.

point.description: Grounded point read from a versioned source; absent on inline threads and PR questions.

duplicate_of.description: Per-PR number of the linked point; each inline thread keeps its own item.

no.description: Per-PR number shown as `C<no>`, assigned at first sight, never reused.

stable_key.description:
Stable key: the bot's `dedupe=` marker, else the thread node id; review id + ordinal for body items;
`pr:<round>:merge` / `pr:<round>:dismiss` for PR-level questions.

author.description: Author's GitHub login (`diffpilot` for PR-level questions).

url.description: GitHub link (thread, review or comment); null for PR-level questions.

title.description: Title: the bot's finding heading or the first line; plain text.

body.description: Comment text (GitHub): plain text, rendered as text; links only to `https://github.com/…`.

bot_severity.description: The bot's own severity words (e.g. `Blocking`), shown with the GitHub tag; a claim, not a fact.

gates.description: Gates from the assessment or the owner.

revision.description: Revision; a decision names the revision it saw (409 `item_changed` otherwise).

first_seen_head.description: Head when diffpilot first read it (not the head the comment was written on).

first_round.description: Bot round when first read; null before the first round.

written.description:
Where GitHub says the comment was written, from the latest read; absent when that read gives no time (an
item it no longer produces, a read stored before this was kept).

gone_at.description:
When a complete read of the pull request first no longer produced it (deleted on GitHub, or no longer an
item by the read rules, such as a person's earlier review); absent while reads produce it. Such an item
leaves the queue, "Decide the rest" and bulk decisions; its decisions stay.

repeat_of.description: The item whose decision this repeat carried or re-asks (`C<no>`).

decisions.description: Decisions, oldest first; the last is current.

ask_answers.description: Answers in the Ask chat about this item.

ImportedGithubDecision.description: Decision evidence shown on a comment item.

DecisionKind.description: A decision (D1–D7; D8 is `reject` with a `blocker_gate` override; P1–P4 for PR-level questions). Open enum.

oneOf.description: D2: fix in this pull request.
D3: reject (with a reason); D8 with a `blocker_gate` override.
D4: handled in an existing pull request.
D5: create a follow-up pull request.
D7: TODO, out of scope for this pull request.
P1: merge now, remaining items become follow-ups.
P3: dismiss the listed stale bot reviews.

CommentPoint.description: Point provenance, grounded in the source's cleaned GitHub text.

source_kind.description: Submitted review body or PR comment.

quote.description: Distinct verbatim span: 12–600 characters, or the whole shorter source.

CommentSourceKind.description: Stored source kind; inline threads remain independent items.

CommentItemId.description: Identifier of a review-loop item (a PR review comment, review-body item or PR-level question).

CommentItemKind.description: Where an item comes from (plan §2.1 I1–I4). Open enum.

oneOf.description: I2: an item of a review body (no thread).
I3: an item of a human PR-level comment.
I4: a PR-level question built by the server from rounds (merge now, dismiss stale reviews).

AuthorKind.description: Who wrote the item: the bot rule (`Bot` type, `[bot]` login or Settings `known_bots`, RQ17).

oneOf.description: A person (also `claude` unless listed as a bot).
A bot by the bot rule.

ItemLocation.description:
The lines an item discusses: at the head for a thread; for a body item naming `path:range`, at the review's
commit, which may predate the head.

lines.description: The lines; null for a file-level or outdated thread without a head line.

LineRange.description: Lines `start_line..=end_line`, 1-based, on the side given by the enclosing type.

GateMark.description: A gate on an item and who set it.

Gate.description: A blocker gate of claudius `severity` §2. Gate items are never grouped or bulk-decided (RQ4, RQ5). Open enum.

GateSource.description: Who marked a gate on an item.

oneOf.description: Reserved: the server does not set it; a pass running for an item shows as its `assessment_state` `running`.
The owner asked about it in the Ask chat; the answer is pending or unread.
Decided; no effect left for an executor.
Decided; effects are open or claimed.
A repeat that carried an earlier decision without a question.

A repeat asked again (bot edit or code change), a person's decided thread raised again, or reopened by the
owner.
Resolved on GitHub outside diffpilot; out of the queue, nothing recorded.

CommitSha.description: A full 40-character hexadecimal git commit id.

Written.description: The commit and time a comment was written on, as GitHub records them.

round.description:
The bot round whose own review raised it (then `commit` and `at` are that round's head and end); absent for
any other comment.

commit.description: The commit its review was made on; absent for a PR comment or a review GitHub did not list.

at.description: When it was written (the review's submission, the comment's creation).

ItemGithubFacts.description: Facts diffpilot read from GitHub about an item (badges name the check).

resolved.description: Thread resolved on GitHub; null for items without a thread.

outdated.description: Thread outdated (its lines changed since it was written); null without a thread.

bot_status.description: The bot's own thread status, when it writes one.

edited_after_decision.description: The comment text changed after the latest decision (normalised text hash, spike S13-1 K1).

replies.description: Replies in the thread after the first comment.

marker.description: The bot's thepastaclaw `dedupe=` marker, when present.

BotThreadStatus.description:
thepastaclaw's own status of a thread, read from its status block (spike S13-1 M4); a GitHub fact, not a
decision. Open enum.

OutsideResolution.description: An item resolved or answered on GitHub outside diffpilot (US17).

seen_at.description: When diffpilot first read it resolved.

AssessmentState.description: Whether an item has an LLM assessment.

oneOf.description: The item waits for the next pass.
The item is in the live pass input.
Not assessed: asked without a recommendation ("Not assessed: <reason>").

NotAssessedReason.description: Why an item has no assessment. Open enum.

oneOf.description: The user's daily assessment limit is reached.
The pass left this item out of its output.
No assessment pass has run for it yet.

CommentAssessment.description: The LLM assessment of one item at one head (`verify_comments`).

proposed_decision.description: Original host proposal, preserving targets beyond the legacy action form.

evidence_text.description: Evidence from the report, labelled LLM text.

recorded_decision.description: Attributed prior decision; authority and grounding are verified by server ingest.

reused_since.description: Reused from this head: comment text, code at the lines and PR purpose unchanged since (fingerprint).

pre_existing.description: The problem exists on the base already.

skills_commit.description:
Commit of the claudius checkout whose skills the job read ("Assessed with claudius <short sha>"); null when
the runner gave none or the assessment predates it. A reused assessment keeps the commit it was made with.

ProposedDecision.description: Machine-readable proposed action; target semantics are validated by the server.

ProposedDecisionKind.description: Proposed decision kind; independent of PR-level decisions.

RecordedDecision.description: Attributed prior decision; server verifies authority and grounding before treating it as a fact.

on_behalf_of.description: Named maintainer for an explicit trusted relay; never inferred.

quote.description: Verbatim decision quote, at most 600 characters.

RecordedDecisionKind.description: Recorded decision kind, including deferral and withdrawal.

JobId.description: Identifier of a job (one agent run).

Validity.description: The LLM's validity reading ("The LLM says: …"). Open enum.

oneOf.description: Already fixed at the assessed head.

AssessmentEvidence.description: A line read that supports the validity reading.

better_pr.description: Better-fitting pull request (`owner/repo#n` or URL) for `out`.

NecessityVerdict.description: Whether the fix belongs in this pull request.

Elsewhere.description: A place where the matter is handled already.

ElsewhereKind.description: Where else the matter is handled. Open enum.

Recommendation.description: The LLM's recommendation; on the card under the evidence, the recommended option first (RQ7).

reason_class.description: Short class of the reason; groups share kind and class or target (plan §2.4).

number.description: Its number in the same repository.

oneOf.description: D5: the follow-up pull request's title (prefilled; optional).
D6: an issue URL, or null to create one.

CodeSummary.description: The enclosing code of the discussed lines and what it does.

description.description: One paragraph on what the code does (LLM).

Decision.description: A stored decision (append-only) with its effects.

imported.description: Evidence and authority for a decision imported from GitHub.

follows.description: Item number of the primary whose decision this follows.

reason.description: Reason (D3, D8; posted as the reply).

resolve_ticked.description: "Resolve this thread" as submitted: the explicit resolve decision.

reply_text.description: The reply text that gets posted (English).

comment.description: The owner's comment: stored, sent to the executing agent, never posted to GitHub.

recommendation.description: The recommendation shown at decision time.

carried_from.description: The decision this one was carried from.

decided_by.description: GitHub login of the deciding user (`carried` decisions: of the source decision).

undone_at.description:
When the owner undid it (before any effect was claimed); its effects are cancelled and the item is asked
again. Absent while it stands.

ImportedDecision.description: An imported decision's source and grounded evidence.

by.description: GitHub login of the decision's author.

by_id.description: Numeric GitHub user id when available.

at.description: When the statement was made on GitHub.

relay.description: GitHub login of the linked account that relayed the member's decision.

DecisionId.description: Identifier of a decision on a review-loop item (append-only).

oneOf.description: Fix although the necessity verdict is `out`.
D8: accept despite the gate (reason required, posted; thread always resolved).

DecisionVia.description: Where a decision was made. Open enum.

oneOf.description: The recorded decision was verified and imported from GitHub.
The decision was propagated from the item's primary.

after.description: `seq` of the effect this one waits for (a reply after a fix waits for its commit).

seen_on_github_at.description: When a server read found the effect on GitHub (fact badge).

EffectId.description: Identifier of one effect of a decision (reply, resolve, fix, …).

EffectKind.description: Kind of an effect; also an executor capability. Open enum.

oneOf.description: PR-level comment (replies to body and PR-comment items).
Create a draft follow-up pull request.
Create an upstream issue (and the "Known limitation" body line).
An external agent through the decision feed.

EffectParams.description: Parameters of an effect, set by the server's effect function.

text.description: Text to post (reply, PR-level comment, dismissal message).

review_id.description: GitHub review node id (dismiss; PR-level replies to a review's items).

url.description: Existing issue URL (D6 with a link).

item_nos.description: Items listed in a follow-up PR (P1), `C<no>`.

oneOf.description: Waits for the effect named by `after`.
Cancelled by a superseding decision before it was claimed.

ClaimInfo.description: The claim on an effect's decision.

token_name.description: Name of the claiming access token.

lease_until.description: Lease end; renewed by each report.

EffectReport.description: A stored agent report ("Agent <token name> reports: …").

ReportOutcome.description: Outcome an agent reports for an effect.

oneOf.description: Done, with a reference (commit, comment URL, PR, TODO id).
